title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Mobile Deposit Limits and New-Account Check Holds
content:
For the Savings & Money Market Accounts family, the tier sets how much check value may come in by mobile deposit and how long a check deposited to a young account waits before it posts. The figures below apply to every tier listed.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Mobile deposit per calendar day, at most (USD) | Mobile deposit in any rolling 30 calendar days, at most (USD) | Business day after deposit on which a check posts while the account is new | Calendar days after opening during which the account counts as new |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 1000.00 | 3000.00 | 5th | 30 |
| Statement Savings | 2500.00 | 7500.00 | 5th | 30 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 2500.00 | 7500.00 | 5th | 30 |
| Money Market Account | 5000.00 | 15000.00 | 5th | 30 |
| Premier Money Market | 10000.00 | 30000.00 | 5th | 30 |
| Private Client Money Market | 25000.00 | 75000.00 | 5th | 30 |

## Meaning

- The two mobile figures cap check value deposited through the mobile app, one per calendar day and one over any rolling window of 30 calendar days.
- The hold figure names which business day after the deposit a check posts on, for an account that is still inside its new-account period.
- The new-account period is counted in calendar days from the opening date.

## Quick answers

**Is the 30-day mobile figure a calendar-month allowance?** No; it is a rolling span of 30 calendar days.

**Does the hold figure differ between tiers?** No, every tier uses the fifth business day and a 30-day new-account period.
